paragraphs.text: Jaeuhl Carthalion (JAY-ull kar-THAL-ee-an) of the Carthalion lineage was a valiant Knight of Kjeldor in the latter part of Dominaria's Ice Age .
Like all the known members of his lineage, Jaeuhl had dark hair and an athletic build, but he had a notably higher concentration of Elvish blood, visible in his eyes and ears.

At a time when his line had lost its prestige, five hundred years after the deeds of his ancestor Jason Carthalion , Jaeuhl lived as an Advocate of the Juniper Order . He was but an inexperienced knight when the planeswalker Freyalise enlisted him to banish Tevesh Szat from Dominaria.

Equipped with the Celestial Sword , Nova Pentacle , and Staff of the Ages , Jaeuhl fought off Szat's undead and found the Amulet of Quoz . Using the Amulet, Jaeuhl banished Szat to Shandalar . With Freyalise's aid, he met and soon fell in love with Kaysa , who became pregnant with his child a decade after the casting of the World Spell . According to the Battlemage game, their daughter was named Jasha Carthalion .

He, Jaya Ballard , and the Knights of Kjeldor later accompanied Kaysa, Laina , Taaveti and other Fyndhorn Elves into Yavimaya . He destroyed a Phyrexian War Beast there with his Celestial Sword. While in Yavimaya, they were also attacked by plants , but eventually allied with the Gorilla Chieftain of Yavimaya and helped cleanse the Heart of Yavimaya .
The Staff of Ice Lords , Nova Pentacle , and a Celestial Sword , given to Jaeuhl by Freyalise in preparation for his fight with Tevesh Szat .
The Amulet of Quoz, recovered from the Labyrinth of Raynor .
